playbookOutputs: Official SARS Notice of Registration (IT150) confirming your 10-digit SARS Income Tax Reference Number
Verification of demographic details linked to your ID/Passport on the SARS system
playbookCommonFailures: Taxpayer was never registered for Income Tax with SARS (requires new SARS Tax Number Registration instead of retrieval)
ID number or passport number on file with SARS is linked to a legacy passport or mismatched surname
Missing signed Power of Attorney or selfie verification required for SARS practitioner lookup

informationToProvide.label: Full Name, Surname & SA ID / Passport Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Your full legal names, surname (including any previous maiden surname registered with SARS), and 13-digit SA ID or passport number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Taxpayer full legal names, surname, and 13-digit SA ID or passport number.

informationToProvide.label: Current Cellphone, Email & Last Known Employer Name
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your current cell number, email address, and the name of the employer who registered you or issued an IRP5.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Taxpayer contact details and last known employer for SARS profile matching.

informationToProvide.label: Certified Copy of South African ID or Passport
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a clear certified copy of your SA ID or Passport.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified South African ID document or passport of the individual.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a recent municipal utility bill, bank statement, or lease agreement showing your physical address.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within the last 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Power of Attorney (Authorizing SARS Tax Number Retrieval)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the signed SARS Power of Attorney authorizing My Accountant to query your tax number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed Power of Attorney authorizing My Accountant to retrieve the taxpayer IT150 Notice of Registration.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect ID, proof of address, contact history and signed POA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Full name, ID/passport number, certified ID, proof of address, and signed POA are on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify that the 13-digit SA ID number or passport number matches the uploaded ID document and signed POA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify identity documents and check SARS eFiling / Practitioner lookup
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Identity documents verified and taxpayer registration status confirmed
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify the ID and POA signatures match. Prepare the taxpayer details for the SARS Tax Practitioner Taxpayer Lookup / IT150 request.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Retrieve IT150 Notice of Registration via SARS eFiling / SARS Online Query
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Official SARS IT150 Notice of Registration PDF retrieved showing the 10-digit Income Tax number
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Use the SARS Tax Practitioner portal / SARS Online Query System (SOQS) "Notice of Registration (IT150)" lookup using the client's ID number and demographic details to retrieve the official IT150 PDF.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver official SARS Notice of Registration (IT150) to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Official IT150 PDF and tax reference number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the official SARS IT150 Notice of Registration PDF and clearly state the 10-digit Income Tax Reference Number in the message.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the tax number retrieval order is complete
